name: HTS_SCHEDULE_GEN_PROFILES_B_
description: Base table containing schedule generation profile information used to generate schedules.

columns.name: SCHED_GEN_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Primary key. Unique system generated identifier for a schedule generation profile

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Standard Enterprise Identifier column for multi tenancy support

columns.name: SCHED_PROFILE_CODE
columns.description: Schedule Generation Profile Code

columns.name: ACTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Schedule Generation Profile Active Start Date

columns.name: ACTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Schedule Generation Profile Active End Date

columns.name: SCHEDULE_PERIOD_WEEKS
columns.description: Schedule Period Cycle in Weeks

columns.name: SCHEDULE_PERIOD_START_DATE
columns.description: Schedule Period Start Date

columns.name: GEN_WINDOW_START
columns.description: Number of days before the schedule period starts to open the schedule generation window.

columns.name: GEN_WINDOW_END
columns.description: Number of days before the schedule period starts to close the schedule generation window.

columns.name: SELF_SCHED_START_OFFSET
columns.description: Number of days before the schedule period starts to open the self scheduling window.

columns.name: SELF_SCHED_END_OFFSET
columns.description: Number of days before the schedule period starts to close the self scheduling window.

columns.name: START_OF_WORK_WEEK
columns.description: First Day of the Schedule Period Week

columns.name: MON_IS_WEEKEND_FLAG
columns.description: MON_IS_WEEKEND_FLAG

columns.description: SAT_IS_WEEKEND_FLAG

columns.name: SUN_IS_WEEKEND_FLAG
columns.description: SUN_IS_WEEKEND_FLAG

columns.name: AUTO_GENERATE_SCHED_FLAG
columns.description: Specify if the schedule is automatically generated when the schedule generation window opens.

columns.name: AUTO_GENERATE_TYPE
columns.description: When the schedule is automatically generated, specify the generation method type, such as open shift or automatic assignment.

columns.name: AUTO_PUBLISH_SCHED_FLAG
columns.description: Specify if the schedule is automatically published 1 day after the schedule generation window closes.

columns.name: ALERT_FINALIZE_FLAG
columns.description: Specify whether to send schedulers notifications to finalize their schedules.

columns.name: ALERT_FINALIZE_DAYS_OFFSET

columns.name: JOB_POS_INCL_EXCL_RULE
columns.description: JOB_POS_INCL_EXCL_RULE

columns.description: Indicates whether a profile is still in draft mode and has not been fully validated.

columns.name: RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: RULE_SET_ID

columns.name: DAY_START_TIME_OFFSET
columns.description: Day Start Time offset

columns.name: FLOAT_BETWEEN_DEPTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to define if workers can float between departments of the schedule generation profile

columns.name: FLOAT_POOL_DEPTS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicator to define if self scheduling allowed for float pool department workers

columns.name: GRACE_PERIOD
columns.description: Clock integration Threshold to ignore violation

columns.description: Clock integration start early grace period for violation

columns.name: END_EARLY_PERIOD
columns.description: Clock integration end early grace period for violation

columns.name: END_LATE_PERIOD
columns.description: Clock integration end late grace period for violation

columns.name: START_EARLY_VIOLATION_TYPE
columns.description: Clock integration start early violation message

columns.name: START_LATE_VIOLATION_TYPE
columns.description: Clock integration start late violation message

columns.name: END_EARLY_VIOLATION_TYPE
columns.description: Clock integration end early violation message

columns.name: END_LATE_VIOLATION_TYPE
columns.description: Clock integration end late violation message

columns.name: SELF_SCHED_RTN_ENABLED_FLAG

columns.name: SELF_SCHED_ROTATION_TYPE
columns.description: Rotation Type used for Self-scheduling

columns.name: SELF_SCHED_RTN_LAST_UPD_DATE
columns.description: Specifies the date when self-scheduling rotation is last updated.

columns.name: DEVIATION_ALLOW_TIME_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether time deviation is allowed for operating shifts.

columns.description: Indicates the default deviation allowance in minutes for operating shift start time.

columns.name: DEVIATION_ALLOW_END_MINUTES
